from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_PROMPT_C],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SUDOKU_STAR_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT)
        draft = await star(problem)
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_DEBATE_PROMPT_1, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_DEBATE_PROMPT_2, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_DEBATE_PROMPT_3],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SUDOKU_DEBATE_AGGREGATOR_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        solution = await debate(f"Puzzle:\n{problem}\n\nDraft candidate:\n{draft['response']}")
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm:
            aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        else:
            aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": worker_usage,
            "aggregator": aggregator_usage,
        }
